## Checklist

- [ ] I did **not** hand-write API facts. Endpoints, headers, fields, and error codes
      belong in `references/`, which is generated by `tools/ingest_docs.py`. If a page
      converts badly, I fixed the converter rather than its output.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or account numbers are included — not even expired
      sandbox ones.
- [ ] `pytest tests/ -v` passes.
- [ ] `python skills/loop-api/scripts/validate_skill.py` passes.

## If you changed the skill's `description`

The `description` in `SKILL.md` frontmatter is the only thing a harness reads when
deciding whether to load the skill, so a change there affects whether it triggers at all.

- [ ] I added trigger cases to `evals/trigger-evals.json` covering both what should
      and shouldn't pull the skill in — the near-misses are the useful ones.
